Trivia Quiz Game

A real trivia quiz with a built-in bank of 50 questions — 10 random questions per round, four options each, instant scoring.

📖 How to use

  1. Press Start quiz.
  2. Answer 10 random questions from the 50-question bank.
  3. See your score with correct answers revealed.
  4. Try to beat your best score.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How many questions are there?

50 real questions across science, history, geography, sports, arts and tech. Each round draws 10 at random.

How does scoring work?

Four options per question, one correct answer, scored instantly with the right answer shown.

Is my high score saved?

Your best score out of 10 is saved in this browser.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes — fully playable on mobile.
